# Combat Overhaul: Reanimated

Author: Aoldri. Source: https://mods.vintagestory.at/combatoverhaulreanimated
Vendored animation data from CombatOverhaulReanimated_1.0.0.zip; MIT license,
copyright 2025 Aoldri. The upstream LICENSE is preserved verbatim here and in the
built mod. `clips.json` consolidates its 23 animation entries without changing
poses. Runtime integration removes native callbacks and retimes phase copies;
the original mod's version-specific item patches are not installed.
